row_B_land_reset.what: land reset: synchroniser at the land centroid + relay flops on its source
row_B_land_reset.cycles: reset release of the land block +N (N = relay count per type below); reset-only, no data lane K
row_B_land_reset.wiring: bound RTL: u_u_land.rst_n is lepk_i0_q[0] (bit 0 of the registered E-face lepk_i0 bus); insert N relay flops between lepk_i0_q[0] and u_u_land.rst_n at relay_sites, and site u_u_land.u_rstr (ot_rst_relay, 3 flops) at land_centroid. Mechanism: an internal_stations entry on that 1-bit conn if the bind accepts a 1-bit reset conn, else a kit_rtl_post relay.
row_B_land_reset.basis: sites = equal Manhattan steps from the lepk_i0 E-face window start to the centroid of the 5 land SRAMs in the plan (COORD: plan geometry); mu kit measured the same thing: synchroniser at (1433,11), 2,270 land registers centred (429,345), 62 ends to -520 ps
